base.campaign_note: Fixed-time count-matched mother bank for the sampling-mode check (R3d): dense periodic snapshots (every 250 sweeps) so that states at a common later-selected time with D in the 5%-equivalent count window can be harvested; selection is outcome-blind (D count and clean clock only).

selection_rationale: Outcome-blind dense-snapshot bank: no hypothesis tested on this batch; mothers are later chosen at one fixed time by defector-count window and clean event clock only.
